lines: The manor's form continued to crumble away.
The fire had not yet abated, and the scorching heat was consuming everything.
Tokiko had escaped safely from the collapsing residence with Kotaro in tow.
However, their regrouped allies had already been reduced to less than half.
They had either been cut down by enemy blades, or burned to ashes in the fiery blaze.
To these few remaining retainers, Tokiko made her declaration.
Tokiko
I've saved the young lord! Your struggle wasn't in vain!
Fuma Ninja
We're so glad you're safe, young lord!
Fuma Ninja
The heir to the Fuma head family is alive!
Fuma Kunoichi
Of course, they're only Igawa Ninja!
Fuma Ninja
The Fuma will not perish!!
There wasn't a single one among them left uninjured.
Except for the young head of the family whom they, along with their fallen comrades, had put their lives on the line to defend.
Tokiko
We must now open up an escape route and save the young lord, no, your new master! Now is the time to show our loyalty!!!
Fuma Ninja

"Yaaaaaaaahh!!!"
"Yaaaaaaaahh!!!"
"Yaaaaaaaahh!!!"
Tokiko's brave figure, unbelievable for an 11-year-old girl, had brought the retainer's morale to a fever pitch.
Even those on the brink of death seemingly awaiting their demise, attempted to rise up.
Kotaro
The young head of the family gazed out at those retainers, overwhelmed by the sight of it.
Tokiko
Your orders, master.
Kotaro
R-, right...
Kotaro's young heart was eagerly stirred to action.
Kotaro
E-, everybody, break through the siege of the Igawa Ninja Forces under Tokiko's command!
Fuma Ninja

"""By your will!!""
""By your will!!""
""By your will!!""
""By your will!!"""
